newsitem.title: USA: Sacramento County, Calif., faces $19.7 mln deficit.
newsitem.headline: Sacramento County, Calif., faces $19.7 mln deficit.

text.p: Sacramento County, Calif., faces a $19.7 million budget shortfall in its 1997-1998 fiscal year, an improvement from earlier forecasts of a $25 million deficit, according to a county report.

County departments are requesting $307 million in funding to run programs, while the county is expected to bring in $287.3 million in general revenues during the fiscal year that begins July 1, according to the revised budget report.
The entire general fund budget is $1.2 billion.

The revised budget estimates will be presented to county supervisors Tuesday. At the meeting, supervisors will also consider ways to reduce the budget deficit to $15 million through cost-cutting measures.
